questions.question: Which language should power the Knowledge Brain API?
questions.rationale: The requested FastAPI/Pydantic AI implementation is Python-based.

options.label: Python
options.description: Use Python with FastAPI, Pydantic, and the requested ingestion and retrieval libraries.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Use a Node.js API instead of the requested Python stack.

questions.question: Which framework and application style should the API use?
questions.rationale: The requested endpoints and AI consultant behavior explicitly require FastAPI/Pydantic AI.

options.label: FastAPI with Pydantic AI
options.description: Build the requested typed, async-friendly Python API and consultant orchestration.

options.label: FastAPI without Pydantic AI
options.description: Use FastAPI while omitting the requested Pydantic AI integration.

questions.question: Which persistence and retrieval stores does the application need?
questions.rationale: The application must persist ingested chunks and retrieve them with ChromaDB-backed hybrid RAG.

options.label: ChromaDB
options.description: Persist document chunks and metadata for local vector retrieval.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Use a relational database for application records.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Store uploaded or generated files and media.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use in-memory state only; this is exclusive with other choices.

questions.question: Should users sign in to access the application API features?
questions.rationale: The requested capstone endpoints do not specify user accounts or protected API access.

options.label: No
options.description: Keep the local capstone API unauthenticated.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Require signed-in users before serving API features.
